scope: admin release notify, user update notification, download page redeploy

rootCause.adminOfflineUi: The admin UI marked the API as offline after /release/notify returned HTTP 500.
rootCause.permissionFailure: The Admin API process runs as ecorex while the current release manifest is owned by root, so writing current/manifest.json can fail with PermissionError.
rootCause.userNotificationGap: The Web runtime preferred public manifest release notice and did not expose local update-state noticeRevision/message, so a freshly written admin notice could be hidden by older public manifest state.

fixes: Persist release notices to the Admin API writable data file release-notice.json before attempting any release manifest write.
Treat release manifest writes as best-effort and return manifestNoticeWritten/manifestNoticeError without leaking paths.
Teach Web update checks and /api/version to read enterprise release notices and local update-state noticeRevision/message.
Keep admin UI connected when a business request returns an HTTP error; only network/state refresh failures should show offline.

privacy.publicNoticePayload: revision, version, message, publishedAt, reason, redacted

localValidation.globalPytestPluginIssue: Initial pytest invocation without PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD failed because the local global langsmith plugin imports an incompatible pydantic-core.
